source.title: Robonine: Testing of Feetech STS3215 Servomotor: Backlash, Repeatability, and Torque

claims.source: Feetech datasheet limit of 0.5 deg or less, as quoted by Robonine

notes: Angular backlash of 0.0151 rad (about 0.87 deg). The servo also has a 10-count firmware dead zone, so part of the play may be control rather than gears.
